content:
cat << 'EOF' > /work/dedupe.py
import sys

def main(file1, file2, outfile):
    with open(file1) as f1, open(file2) as f2:
        lines1 = set(line.strip() for line in f1 if line.strip())
        lines2 = set(line.strip() for line in f2 if line.strip())
    duplicates = sorted(lines1 & lines2)
    with open(outfile, 'w') as out:
        for line in duplicates:
            out.write(line + '\n')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 4:
        print(f"Usage: {sys.argv[0]} <file1> <file2> <output>")
        sys.exit(1)
    main(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3])
EOF
